questions.reply: You named the real break: you overrode the SMT you said you needed, then let off-chart frustration tilt the short and the rest of the day. That "I don't think we need it now" move is the revenge-trading crack, not the loss itself. Monday the rule is locked — if the SMT you wrote for is not there, you sit. Keep the outside habits separate so they cannot bleed into the next click.
